## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes locally (with `SAM_HOME` / `SAM_INSTALL_HOME` pointed at temp dirs, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New behavior or the fixed bug has a test
- [ ] No new npm dependencies
- [ ] Token budgets unchanged, or the change is measured (`npm run bench`, `sam context`)
- [ ] `README.md` and `README.tr.md` updated together (or translation needed: say so)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry under `## [Unreleased]`
